title: Careers
description: Careers at Neil Smith Construction: field and trades, project delivery and engineering roles on public infrastructure across Metro Vancouver.

hero.title: Build what’s next
hero.subtitle: We are growing across Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley, and we are hiring people who take pride in doing civil work safely and well.

image.alt: NSC crew setting a precast manhole on Kingston Road

blocks.title: A career in the ground.
blocks.intro: Public infrastructure, real responsibility and a team that backs you up.

items.title: Work that matters
items.text: Sewers, watermains and school sites that communities rely on for decades.

items.title: Learn from the best
items.text: Work beside superintendents and foremen with 15 to 20+ years in civil construction.

items.title: Safety first, always
items.text: COR certified program, a safety officer on our sites and a toolbox meeting every shift.

items.title: Room to grow
items.text: We invest in learning, so safe and efficient work becomes second nature and people move up.

blocks.title: Find your place on the team.

items.title: Field and trades
items.text: Pipelayers, equipment operators, labourers, foremen and superintendents.

items.title: Project delivery
items.text: Project managers, project coordinators and estimators.

items.title: Engineering and technical
items.text: Construction technologists, EITs, QA/QC and utility coordination.

blocks.title: We’re hiring.
blocks.intro: Send your resume to info@nscltd.ca with the position in the subject line. Don’t see your role? Send it anyway.
